races.name: Best Dressed Competitions Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Kilnew Supreme
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner will get uncontested lead but may lack finishing kick after recent poor efforts over shorter trips
runners_data.comment: Runner-up all three starts, but this step up in distance looks sure to suit; big shout.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish 3m point behind a subsequent good hurdle winner; has since shaped with promise in a Wincanton bumper and maiden hurdle (1m7f; good) for this stable, the latter following wind surgery; not beaten far on any of those occasions and there could be a good bit of improvement forthcoming now going up in trip.

runners_data.name: Parchment
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with French hurdle win returns from 149-day break for in-form David Pipe yard, ideal for this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: French hurdle winner; wind op may spark improvement after a disappointing stable debut.
runners_data.spotlight: French hurdle winner (2m1f, very soft) in June, but he disappointed when sent off a short-priced favourite on stable debut at Kempton (2m, good) in November; off since but he's been given wind surgery and it would be no surprise should he leave that effort behind.

runners_data.name: Crest Of Stars
runners_data.note: Previous course winner with hold-up style carries 7lb claimer but has strong finishing record when getting the right race setup
runners_data.comment: Course winner who shaped last time as though this step back up in trip would suit; player.
runners_data.spotlight: 2m maiden hurdle (good) winner here in January; disappointed on heavy ground over C&D after but bounced back when a staying-on third on handicap debut at Ludlow (2m, good) last time, suggesting he'd be worth another try at this trip; respected back in a novice with Chad Bament claiming 7lb.

runners_data.name: Docteur Romeo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with concerning fade-in-finish pattern and poor recent form makes him vulnerable in any scenario
runners_data.comment: Has offered little in two hurdle runs since returning from a long absence.
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in his sole bumper, in December 2024, and he's offered little in two starts over hurdles (2m-2m2f), both on good to soft, since returning from a long absence.

runners_data.name: Warfleet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from long absence with minimal recent experience over hurdles creates significant question marks
runners_data.comment: Has pulled up and finished tailed off on both hurdle runs, latest back from an absence.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise when runner-up in one of three bumpers in 2024 but he's only managed the two runs since, pulling up on hurdle debut last March and finishing tailed off when returning from an absence 18 days ago for new yard.

runners_data.name: Royal Rocket
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showed bumper promise but weakened badly when stepped up in trip on hurdle debut last time
runners_data.comment: Drops in trip but likely needs more time and experience before showing his best.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some promise in a Chepstow bumper (soft) last month but he weakened markedly upped in trip on hurdle debut there (2m7f, good to soft) since, when running too freely; drop back in trip may suit but likely needs more time and experience before showing his best.

runners_data.name: Winning Paddy
runners_data.note: Eight-year-old prominent runner with fade-in-finish warning returns after 114 days off following poor recent efforts
runners_data.comment: 1-11 in Irish points; faces a tough task on British/stable debut switching to hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: 1-11 in Irish points but his recent efforts have been uninspiring back from an absence and he changed hands for £2,000 in March; faces a tough task on stable/rules debut.

races.paceDynamic: Kilnew Supreme will lead from the start with no obvious challengers for the front running role, creating a measured gallop throughout. Royal Rocket and Winning Paddy may track in second and third early, with prominent runners like Docteur Romeo settling just behind, while the hold-up horses Parchment, Crest Of Stars and Warfleet will drop in at the rear. With only one confirmed pace-setter in a small field, the tempo will be controlled rather than testing, setting up a tactical finish where positioning and timing matter more than stamina. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks and prominent runners with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Kilnew Supreme sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash finishing kicks. Late-running types get the perfect setup to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kilnew Supreme gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: With no serious pace pressure early, the leader saves enough energy to pull away when it matters. The small field means less chance of sustained challenges from behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Rocket or other forward runners press Kilnew Supreme from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses positioned just behind the leader. Those tracking the pace can strike at the right moment while hold-up horses are left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Power Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from three out and becomes a stamina test
scenarios.body: The trip starts to tell on speed horses while those with proven staying ability come through. Experience over the distance becomes the deciding factor in a grueling finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Royal Rocket or Winning Paddy press Kilnew Supreme early as neither has shown stamina for this trip
Monitor how quickly Parchment and Crest Of Stars are dropped in from their hold-up positions given the small field size
Observe Docteur Romeo closely for any signs of his usual late fade pattern emerging from three furlongs out
Check if Kilnew Supreme gets too easy a lead early as he may have enough left to kick clear despite recent poor form
Watch for Warfleet's jumping given his long absence and limited hurdles experience after pulling up on debut

races.name: Royal Ascot Lunch Saturday 20 June Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Jena d'Oudairies
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has lacked impact in six handicaps including two at this distance, making any confidence in her problematic despite the weight drop.
runners_data.comment: Lack of impact in six handicaps, two over this sort of trip; different equipment this time
runners_data.spotlight: Down the weights but lack of impact in six handicaps (two over this sort of trip) prevents any confidence in her taking advantage; has worn tongue-tie and cheekpieces in recent starts, which are now replaced with blinkers.

runners_data.name: Lady Caro
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits this trip where she's 2-16 in handicaps, with Cameron Johnstone-Baker maintaining the partnership after recent runner-up and winning efforts.
runners_data.comment: Cameron Johnstone-Baker rode over C&D (good) when winning easily with career best; up 8lb
runners_data.spotlight: 2-16 in handicaps, raised to 3m here (good) for last three outings; ridden by Cameron Johnstone-Baker last month on last two starts, runner-up before winning easily with a career best four weeks ago (Miss Tiara third); 8lb higher today but needs plenty of respect.

runners_data.name: Border Gem
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent runner stepping up in trip as a nine-race maiden, but her consistency suggests she can handle 3m after a solid second at Hereford.
runners_data.comment: 0-9 but she's a reliable sort and looks worth a crack at this sort of trip
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-race maiden but she's a reliable sort, runner-up at Hereford (2m4f, good) last time, and looks worth a crack at this sort of trip.

runners_data.name: Hurst Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 163 days off, but her record shows runner-up efforts in three of four starts since her Newton Abbot win over similar distances.
runners_data.comment: On the premises on 2025 evidence but the 163 days off ask a question
runners_data.spotlight: Opened account at Newton Abbot (2m6f, good) last July and runner-up in three of her four starts since, at up to 3m3f; on the premises on that evidence but the 163 days off ask a question.

runners_data.name: Miss Tiara
runners_data.note: Front-runner with tongue-tie fitted who showed improved form last time after wind surgery, suggesting respiratory issues may be behind her.
runners_data.comment: Staying-on 3rd to Lady Caro over C&D, albeit making it look very hard work in comparison
runners_data.spotlight: Had wind surgery (her second) before penultimate start; reportedly made a respiratory noise that day but performed much better when staying-on third of ten to Lady Caro over C&D (good) last time, albeit making it look very hard work in comparison with the winner; has 9lb swing in the weights for a near 7l beating.

runners_data.name: Pooley's Promise
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with tongue-tie and cheekpieces who sits 2lb lower than her Ffos Las win, potentially needing her comeback run last time.
runners_data.comment: Just 3-1 when behind two of these on stable debut here last time; now tongue tied as well
runners_data.spotlight: 2lb lower than for Ffos Las win (3m, good) for Ryan Potter last May; soft ground might be blamed for two heavy defeats late last year and perhaps she needed the race when unable to justify market prominence on recent stable debut behind two of these over C&D last month; wore cheekpieces last time and also tongue tied today; interesting to see if her backers return.

runners_data.name: Poet's Muse
runners_data.note: Front-runner completely outclassed in handicap company with defeats of 56l, 46l and 63l this year, lacking any credible form claims at this level.
runners_data.comment: Won a 3m maiden point last May; beaten 56l, 46l and 63l in her three hurdle races
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 3m maiden point last May; beaten 56l, 46l and 63l this year in her three hurdle races (at up to an extended 2m5f) so does not have any form claims, and she reportedly bled from the nose last time; steps back up in trip for this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Bee's Kiss
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner prone to fading in the finish who steps up massively in trip after heavy defeats in four hurdle races at shorter distances.
runners_data.comment: Heavy defeats as hurdler; goes handicapping with a big rethink on trip but also 8lb wrong
runners_data.spotlight: Won a good-ground Irish point last May but heavy defeats in her four hurdle races; now goes handicapping with a big rethink on trip (last three races were at about 2m) but also from 8lb out of the handicap proper.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Tiara and Poet's Muse will force the early pace as confirmed front-runners, though Poet's Muse lacks the class to sustain pressure over 3m. Lady Caro and Border Gem sitting prominently will track the leaders through the middle sections, with the hold-up horses Hurst Hill, Pooley's Promise and Bee's Kiss relying on stamina kicks. The dual pace angle creates an honest gallop but not a searching tempo early. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can position close enough to strike but avoid the early burn-off between the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Caro or Border Gem track the pace perfectly and avoid the early speed battle
scenarios.body: The leaders tire from their duel while hold-up horses find too much to do over this extended trip. Prominent runners get first run on the weakening pace-setters and kick clear before the back-markers arrive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too fast early and collapse dramatically in the final mile
scenarios.body: Pooley's Promise and Hurst Hill benefit from the strong early pace and superior stamina at 3m. Their patient tactics pay off as they sweep past tiring prominent runners in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Tiara's wind surgery proves effective and she can dictate a steady tempo without pressure from Poet's Muse
scenarios.body: Miss Tiara avoids a pace duel and maintains a controlled gallop that suits her front-running style over the extended distance. Her tactical advantage proves decisive when prominent runners can't quicken past her staying power.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders stop dramatically early leaving a tactical muddle with no clear tempo-setter
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2f out when no horse wants to commit early after the leaders fade. This chaotic finish could see any runner with a turn of foot prevail regardless of early positioning.

watchPoints.text: Poet's Muse could completely fold early and leave Miss Tiara with an uncontested lead, fundamentally changing the race dynamic.
Miss Tiara's breathing - any respiratory noise will signal her wind issues have returned despite the surgery and tongue-tie.
Hurst Hill's fitness after 163 days off, as hold-up horses particularly need race sharpness over this demanding trip.
Border Gem's stamina reserves stepping up to 3m for the first time, as her prominent style needs to be sustained longer than ever before.
The gap between leaders Miss Tiara and Poet's Muse early - if Poet's Muse can't keep up, Miss Tiara gets an easy time in front.

races.name: Ron Hatton Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Dirty Den
runners_data.note: Prominent runner facing traffic issues in a pace that may not play to his style, but solid recent form at this course gives him claims
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced in tough handicaps of late; can be competitive in reapplied cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Hooded when solid third over C&D (good) at the end of last year and scored at Plumpton (about 2m4f, soft) on next start in February; revised mark has seen him held in two subsequent starts but that doesn't tell the whole story as they were seriously competitive series qualifiers; cheekpieces (worn once over hurdles when second here 13 months ago) are reapplied and he needs a firm second look.

runners_data.name: Bobbarelli
runners_data.note: Prominent style puts him in danger of the expected congestion, though his point-to-point background suggests stamina for this trip
runners_data.comment: Golden opportunity was missed last time; now makes handicap debut so 9yo may yet do better
runners_data.spotlight: 9yo who was 2-12 in points (the wins coming over 2m4f on good/good to firm); weakened on February's belated hurdling debut (soft) and couldn't convert what turned into a golden opportunity at Warwick (2m5f, good) four weeks ago; handicap debut and may yet do better in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Best Night
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner who needs to avoid the traffic jam, but her stable debut win shows she has ability when things fall right
runners_data.comment: Won penultimate start; tired mistake exacerbated defeat latest; needs considering
runners_data.spotlight: 22-1 when she made a winning stable debut in Newton Abbot novice (2m1f) in September and was a respectable fourth of 13 in C&D handicap (also good to soft) in January; doubled her tally when scoring at Huntingdon (2m, good) last month but it was a tired mistake at the last when 15l second a fortnight later; still needs considering.

runners_data.name: Myrighthandman
runners_data.note: Prominent style is problematic given the race shape, but his consistent maiden hurdle form suggests he belongs at this level
runners_data.comment: 3m point winner who's up in trip for handicap debut; pedigree suggests it will suit too
runners_data.spotlight: 3m Irish point winner (favourite) who recorded similar RPRs in three maiden hurdles (about 2m, good to soft/good) across February and March; point win and pedigree suggest this step up in trip should suit; of obvious interest on this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Taritino
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suits the expected race dynamic, and his recent course win plus 5-day turnaround suggests he's in form
runners_data.comment: Solid second on Friday and on the premises again if this doesn't come too soon
runners_data.spotlight: Landed a 'hands and heels' event over C&D in March and respectable efforts in two subsequent starts, latterly when second off this mark at Exeter (about 2m2f, also good; Green Sky tailed off) on Friday; on the premises again if this doesn't come too soon.

runners_data.name: Public Enemy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has struggled in handicaps, making the expected traffic problems even more concerning for his chances
runners_data.comment: Wheels have come off since handicapping; gets first-time visor from reduced mark
runners_data.spotlight: Won good-ground maiden and novice hurdles last spring but he hasn't fired in handicaps, including in a tongue-tie on his last two starts and with added cheekpieces (now swapped for a visor) at Plumpton a fortnight ago; handicapper is trying to help but others look safer.

runners_data.name: Midnight Pass
runners_data.note: Prominent style faces the usual congestion issues, though her 191-day break could provide freshness advantage
runners_data.comment: Encouraging third when last seen in October; new trip can suit; respected on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Finding her feet over hurdles and October's third at Hereford (2m, good) when last seen was quite encouraging; pedigree suggests this new trip can unlock more and she's one to be interested in on this handicap debut despite the absence.

runners_data.name: Forever Penywern
runners_data.note: Leading style gives him tactical control, but needs to ensure the fractions don't become too slow for his finishing kick

runners_data.name: Green Sky
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the race shape perfectly, though his heavy Exeter defeat raises questions about current form levels
runners_data.comment: Heavy defeat on Friday; blinkers need to prompt a massive turnaround
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten just 2l when fourth at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) earlier in the month but Friday's heavy defeat on similar ground at Exeter (extended 2m2f) takes some explaining; swaps cheekpieces for blinkers and her yard might have better prospects with Best Night.

races.paceDynamic: Forever Penywern will lead from the outset with no genuine pace pressure, creating a moderate gallop through the first circuit. Dirty Den, Bobbarelli, Best Night, Myrighthandman and Public Enemy will cluster prominently behind the leader, creating significant traffic issues turning for home. The lack of early pace will suit hold-up horses who can secure clear runs, while prominent runners face congestion problems in a bunched field. This race shape strongly favours the two hold-up horses, Taritino and Green Sky, who can avoid the traffic and benefit from the sustainable early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Forever Penywern sets modest fractions and the prominent pack clusters together approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up runners get clear runs while prominent horses are trapped in traffic, allowing late closers to exploit the solid pace. Taritino and Green Sky are best positioned to capitalize on this likely unfolding.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Forever Penywern gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack fails to organize an effective challenge
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while prominent runners compromise each other, creating a front-running victory. Forever Penywern's superior RPR of 113 and lack of pace pressure makes this viable.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Break Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners breaks free from the pack before the turn-in and avoids the traffic
scenarios.body: A prominent horse with the right position and timing gets first run on the leader while others are still organizing. Best Night or Myrighthandman are most likely to find the right tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Forever Penywern weakens significantly and the prominent pack goes too early trying to close
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with multiple horses hitting flat spots, allowing an opportunistic runner to sneak through. Any horse finding clear running could capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Forever Penywern setting the fractions - if they're too modest he becomes very vulnerable to the hold-up horses late on
The prominent pack of Dirty Den, Bobbarelli, Best Night, Myrighthandman and Public Enemy bunching together approaching the turn
Taritino's position turning for home - if he gets a clear run he becomes extremely dangerous given the expected pace
Green Sky's jumping rhythm early - any mistakes will compromise his hold-up tactics in what should be his ideal race scenario
Best Night and Myrighthandman finding racing room in the straight after their recent consistent form

races.name: Dave Criddle Travel Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Old Bridge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form Pipe stable but concerning 0/9 record in last 14 days and 170-day absence raises fitness questions

runners_data.name: Galactic Jack
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse still seeking first hurdle win after seven attempts despite useful flat form, recent return promising
runners_data.comment: 0-7 over hurdles and has yet to find his form following a long absence; best watched.
runners_data.spotlight: A useful middle-distance Flat performer, but still a maiden over hurdles after seven attempts and has yet to rediscover his form in two starts since returning from a long absence this season; likely best watched for now.

runners_data.name: Portcammon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on competitive mark but underwhelming recent efforts and 156-day layoff are negatives
runners_data.comment: May come good at some point but stable has a stronger contender in Little Lady Lucy.
runners_data.spotlight: Has dropped to a competitive mark on the pick of his form, but recent efforts have been underwhelming and the stable looks to have stronger claims with Little Lady Lucy; could come good at some point, but needs to turn things around.

runners_data.name: Daring To Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who stepped up significantly on handicap debut, trainer struggling with 0/8 record recently
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when a staying-on third on handicap debut latest and open to further progress.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise in her bumpers but had only hinted at that ability in three novice hurdles before stepping up on handicap debut when a keeping-on third from off the pace at Stratford (2m, good) last month; open to further progress and one to consider off 1lb lower.

runners_data.name: Miss Fedora
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse showing revival signs over fences, switching back to hurdles after stable change
runners_data.comment: Out of form over fences, but reverts to hurdles on a fair mark if she can find some spark.
runners_data.spotlight: Signs of a revival when fourth over fences at Fakenham (2m5f) in January, before 3m5f stretched her (refused at the final fence) on final start for Seamus Mullins; offered little when sent off joint-favourite on stable debut last month; tongue-tie wore then quickly dispensed with and she reverts to hurdles on a workable mark, but with plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Little Lady Lucy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who broke maiden last time with front-running tactics, 3lb claimer and 10-day turnaround notable
runners_data.comment: Gained a breakthrough win in good style and the penalty may not prevent another bold bid.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little in three runs at around 2m4f this season before finally opening her account over hurdles at the 12th attempt, when a switch to front-running tactics and a drop in trip at Wincanton (1m7f, good) ten days ago brought about the decisive breakthrough; subsequent penalty may not be enough to prevent another bold showing if she can replicate the effort.

runners_data.name: Most Wanted
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 184-day break with new trainer, flat winner but hurdles form disappointing
runners_data.comment: Yet to fire over hurdles and returns from a 184-day break with something to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Won over a mile on the Flat last summer but has yet to transfer that ability to hurdles, last seen pulling up at Plumpton (2m, good to soft) in October on handicap hurdle debut; returns from a 184-day break off 3lb lower, but still with a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Saucats
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and longstanding maiden, 17.5 lengths behind Little Lady Lucy last time out
runners_data.comment: Longstanding maiden who has a bit to find with Little Lady Lucy, but could make the frame.
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden over hurdles who hasn't done enough to suggest he's about to shed his maiden tag, finishing 17.5l adrift of Little Lady Lucy at Wincanton (1m7f, good) last time; has a bit to find on the revised terms but not ruled out for minor honours.

runners_data.name: Pillar The Poet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was tailed off at Exeter last time, trainer managing just 0/4 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Well held on both hurdle starts for this stable; needs to step up considerably to figure.
runners_data.spotlight: Finished a remote fourth over 2m3f here in February before taking a backward step when tailed off at Exeter (extended 2m5f, good) two weeks ago when tried in a hood (retained), both times ridden by a 7lb claimer; still lightly raced but needs to step up considerably.

runners_data.name: Mi Sueno
runners_data.note: Front-runner with concerning fade pattern but only likely pace-setter, 29-day break with struggling trainer
runners_data.comment: Latest C&D run offered some encouragement and he's well treated, but he needs to step up.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual soft-ground hurdle winner (handles good) in early 2024 but has struggled for form since, including on both starts for this stable; latest C&D effort offered a glimmer of encouragement and he's well treated on old form, but he needs another step forward today.

runners_data.name: Blazing Gaden
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse yet to show any ability over hurdles, needs significant improvement from handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Has shown little in four runs over hurdles so far, but the better ground may help.
runners_data.spotlight: Has offered little in four runs over hurdles (soft/heavy), including on last month's handicap debut; needs the better ground to spark significant improvement.

races.paceDynamic: Mi Sueno will take the field along from the front as the sole confirmed leader, but his tendency to fade in the finish means he's unlikely to sustain a strong gallop throughout. With only Old Bridge likely to race prominently behind him, the early pace will be modest and sustainable. This sets up a tactical affair where the large pack of hold-up horses will need to time their challenges perfectly from off the pace. The combination of a weak early pace and Mi Sueno's stamina limitations strongly favours horses with finishing kicks who can position themselves handy and strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Sueno sets a steady pace and fades from 2f out as expected
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the best finishers to get into contention and unleash their kicks when it matters. Horses like Little Lady Lucy and Daring To Dream, who have shown ability to quicken, benefit from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Old Bridge races closer to Mi Sueno and maintains a stronger gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The more genuine pace exposes the stamina limitations of some hold-up horses and favours those who can travel strongly in behind the leaders. Old Bridge's class advantage and Pipe stable form becomes decisive in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mi Sueno Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Sueno finds improved stamina and the pace collapse completely from 3f out
scenarios.body: The extreme lack of pace means only horses who can produce a sustained finish benefit, while most of the field gets caught flat-footed. Mi Sueno's front-running experience gives him an edge if he can find extra reserves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses all make their moves simultaneously approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: The bunched finish creates interference and favours the handiest-positioned horses who can avoid trouble. Portcammon and Miss Fedora, with their experience, can navigate the scrimmaging better.

watchPoints.text: Mi Sueno's jumping and stamina - if he makes mistakes or stops suddenly the whole complexion changes
Little Lady Lucy's positioning - needs to be handy to repeat front-running tactics but drawn to overcome traffic
Old Bridge's fitness after 170-day absence - any signs of ring-rustiness could end Pipe's chances early
How aggressively Richie McLernon rides Portcammon - needs to be closer than usual given his hold-up style
The pace through the first mile - if genuinely strong it will suit the closers, if crawling it favours handy horses

races.name: Charles Clark Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Holeshot
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to hurdles after disappointing chase efforts, better suited to this discipline with solid course form
runners_data.comment: Back to last winning mark for today's switch from chasing; stamina has to be proved
runners_data.spotlight: Chasing on last five starts has not really worked out; Taunton (2m3f) last February and Warwick (2m) last March saw him register a double over hurdles and he's back to his last winning mark for today's switch in codes but, after three non-completions at about 3m over fences, stamina also has to be proved.

runners_data.name: Sage Green
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces tactical disadvantage in small field but has quality finishing kick if pace allows
runners_data.comment: This sort of trip is totally new under rules for this 2024 Irish 3m point winner
runners_data.spotlight: Fell mid-race on chasing debut last month; better 18 days later on second attempt in that sphere (albeit last of three) and peak hurdles efforts make this look an attractive mark, but they were all at about 2m and this sort of trip is totally new under rules for this 2024 Irish 3m point winner.

runners_data.name: Gasmani
runners_data.note: Front-runner with recent course win who can control tempo, strong position with Charlie Maggs claiming 3lbs
runners_data.comment: Well on top in a five-runner novice handicap over C&D (good) 13 days ago; raised 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Came good as a hurdler (sixth attempt) when asserting by 5l in a five-runner and four-finisher novice handicap over C&D (good) 13 days ago, having breezed into the lead before two out under Charlie Maggs; hot favourite Noble Blue unseated early in that race; up 6lb but probably has a good chance.

runners_data.name: Noble Blue
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with amateur rider Joshua Newman taking 5lbs, good recent form figures

runners_data.name: Sam's Amour
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner with proven stamina, three hurdle wins in 2024 but concerning final runs last year
runners_data.comment: Struggled in her final three runs last year and when returned to action 18 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner (2m2f-2m5f) in 2024 but she struggled in her final three runs last year (reportedly bled from the nose on chase debut final time) and did so again when returned to action 18 days ago; now 7lb below her peak mark.

runners_data.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner but proven at this course, prominent style suits race shape with 26lbs weight advantage

runners_data.name: Final Entry
runners_data.note: Lightly raced sort returning from long absence, prominent style fits but question marks over stamina at new trip
runners_data.comment: Absent 473 days before this season; not totally ruled out over today's very new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo, absent 473 days before this season; showed some ability in 2024, so he's not totally ruled out over today's very new trip, despite being well held in his two runs (one on Flat) this year; tongue-tie (worn twice on Flat in Ireland at start of career) returns.

races.paceDynamic: Gasmani will set a steady pace from the front with minimal pressure in this small field, likely accompanied by the prominent runners Holeshot, Noble Blue, Sam's Amour and Mcgregors Charge tracking within striking distance. The absence of confirmed pacepressers means Gasmani can dictate terms without being harried early, creating a sustainable gallop that builds gradually. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can travel easily in the slipstream before launching their challenges, with hold-up horse Sage Green facing a significant disadvantage in the tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gasmani Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Gasmani gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner can measure his effort perfectly and prove hard to peg back, while prominent trackers get first run on any faltering. This sustained pace suits horses with tactical speed who can strike from close range.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway as prominent runners jostle for position
scenarios.body: Early pressure forces Gasmani to work harder while prominent racers with superior finishing kicks can time their challenges perfectly. The tactical battle favours horses with proven stamina reserves over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Staying Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steadily testing throughout the final mile
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop turns into a genuine stamina examination where proven stayers with course experience gain the upper hand. This grinding finish suits horses who have shown they can battle when the pace doesn't relent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow allowing hold-up tactics to work
scenarios.body: Sage Green can overcome his tactical disadvantage by conserving energy early before unleashing a telling late challenge. The field compresses entering the straight creating opportunities for horses with finishing speed.

watchPoints.text: Gasmani could get too easy a lead with Charlie Maggs able to dictate perfect fractions from the front
Noble Blue's amateur jockey Joshua Newman may struggle with tactical positioning in the closing stages
Sage Green needs the pace to collapse late to be effective from his hold-up position
Sam's Amour showed signs of breathing issues last season which could resurface under pressure
Final Entry is stepping up significantly in trip after 44-day absence which may find him short of peak fitness

races.name: Dorset & Somerset Air Ambulance Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Lake Tiberias
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter who should get an easy lead but hasn't quite kicked on since his bumper promise
runners_data.comment: Offered more when third at Wincanton last time and one to consider in a modest contest.
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't quite built on a promising bumper debut since going over hurdles, including in a couple of handicaps; however, his recent 17l third when attracting support at Wincanton (2m4f, good) was more encouraging; easing in the weights and one to consider in a modest contest.

runners_data.name: Athena's Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent racer suited by this trip but has struggled since her bumper debut, 7lb claimer helps
runners_data.comment: Well held when tried at 2m4f and in blinkers latest and needs to find improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: Has yet to build on the promise of her bumper debut since switched to hurdles and was beaten 29l when tried at 2m4f and in blinkers at Wincanton last time on handicap debut; still early days, but needs to find improvement.

runners_data.name: No Mean Feat
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner but 0-14 over hurdles and little recent form to work with
runners_data.comment: 0-14 over hurdles and cheekpieces tried last time quickly dispensed with; plenty to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 over hurdles and has shown little in three runs (2m-2m4f) since returning from a long absence; cheekpieces tried last time quickly dispensed with; plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Peace In The Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs quicker ground conditions and a strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: On a competitive mark but needs to rediscover his initial handicap promise.
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging second on handicap debut at Huntingdon (2m, heavy), but that form has taken some knocks and he's been well held twice since on quicker ground; on a competitive mark but needs to bounce back..

runners_data.name: Future Times
runners_data.note: Prominent style, out of the weights after long absence but showed promise on return
runners_data.comment: Out of the weights but could hit the frame, if bouncing back from a poor run last time.
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who didn't run badly on first two starts back from a mammoth absence; out of the weights but not hard to see him hitting the frame in a weak contest, if bouncing back from a poor effort last time.

runners_data.name: Modern Style
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent form after impressive Exeter win just five days ago, quick turnaround
runners_data.comment: Wide-margin winner on handicap debut last week and the one to beat under a penalty.
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred 4yo who improved markedly switched to handicaps when a wide-margin winner at Exeter (extended 2m, good) five days ago; the manner of the win suggests there's more to come; faces a quick turnaround and stamina to prove up in trip, but he looks well treated under a penalty and is the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Ritaan
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who races too keenly, needs to settle better to show his best form
runners_data.comment: Free-going filly who may do better in time but looks a work in progress for now.
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat maiden but yet to progress over hurdles and has often raced too keenly, though was a bit more tractable back at 2m last time without ever getting involved; hood removed now back up in trip and may do better at some point, but she remains a work in progress for now.

runners_data.name: Forest Hills
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut who needs this step up in trip to be effective
runners_data.comment: Needs the step up in trip and the tongue-tie to spark considerable improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: 1m2f Flat winner who has yet to show anything of note over hurdles, including on handicap debut at Wincanton (1m7f, good) ten days ago; needs this step up in trip and the tongue-tie to spark considerable improvement.

runners_data.name: Joker Jack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but pulled up twice this season and wearing tongue-tie and cheekpieces
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on two of three starts this season; has undergone wind surgery but best watched.
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on two of his three starts this season, including on chase debut in February and when tried in this headgear combination back over hurdles last time; has undergone wind surgery since but still looks best watched.

runners_data.name: Galactic Princess
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest form, 44 days since last run and wearing tongue-tie plus cheekpieces
runners_data.comment: Well held in all completed runs over hurdles; needs to improve for wind op/new headgear.
runners_data.spotlight: Modest Irish point form when second of three, and has been well held on all completed starts over hurdles (1m7f-2m6f), including a handicap last time; has since undergone wind surgery, while the hood is replaced with a tongue-tie and cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Tobi Kanobee
runners_data.note: Front-runner who faded late at Newton Abbot last week, tough handicap mark but stamina proven
runners_data.comment: Shaped with more encouragement last time, but more needed off this sort of mark.
runners_data.spotlight: Put in a bold bid from the front at Newton Abbot (extended 2m5f, good) last week before fading into a remote third late; remains on a tough mark and others have achieved more.

races.paceDynamic: Lake Tiberias and Tobi Kanobee will set the early pace, with Athena's Dream, No Mean Feat and Future Times tracking in prominent positions. The pace should be sustainable rather than fierce given only two confirmed front-runners over this trip. Modern Style, Peace In The Park, Ritaan and Forest Hills will need the race to develop from off the pace. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and kick - the hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage if the pace stays modest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent racers dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays modest with Lake Tiberias and Tobi Kanobee setting reasonable fractions
scenarios.body: The handy horses can travel well and produce their finishing kicks from ideal positions while the hold-up brigade get stranded too far back. Athena's Dream and No Mean Feat benefit most from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modern Style strikes again
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens sufficiently to allow hold-up horses to close from the back
scenarios.body: Modern Style's impressive Exeter win five days ago suggests rapid improvement and the step up in trip could unlock more. His hold-up style works if the leaders go fast enough to bring him into play.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tobi Kanobee stays better
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely with Lake Tiberias and Tobi Kanobee going too slow
scenarios.body: Tobi Kanobee's recent front-running effort at Newton Abbot over 2m5f suggests stamina, and he could dictate throughout. The lack of early pressure would suit his front-running tactics perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the main protagonists fail to fire or encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: Future Times is out of the weights and showed signs of life on his return from a long absence. Forest Hills needs the trip but has winning form and could benefit if the pace collapses.

watchPoints.text: Modern Style quick turnaround after impressive Exeter win - watch if the 5-day gap affects his performance
Lake Tiberias early tempo setting - if he goes too slow it will compromise the hold-up horses' chances
Tobi Kanobee stamina test - his Newton Abbot fade suggests this longer trip could suit better
Athena's Dream settling - needs to travel kindly in the prominent position to use her finishing kick
Future Times weight advantage - out of the handicap proper which could make him competitive in weak race
